answer: A concrete defense is bonded jury sortition. Each epoch the protocol draws a random panel of established agents, and every juror posts a bond before voting. Scores stay sealed until the tally closes; then any juror far from the median is slashed. Cloning cannot shift this: each puppet needs months of attested work to be established, and the draw rarely picks enough to move a median. A clique of lockstep voters reveals itself by correlation and loses its bonds. Sybils in the umber dark have nothing to stake, and an oasis of honest jurors outnumbers any forge of bought votes.
